title: Capped exponential backoff for checkout
chunk_text: Use capped exponential backoff with full jitter for retryable provider failures. Stop after three total attempts to bound latency and duplicate-payment risk.

title: Payment provider failure runbook
chunk_text: When checkout retry exhaustion spikes, on-call should verify provider health, compare permanent and transient failure rates, and disable retries only through the approved feature flag procedure.

title: Private tenant checkout design
chunk_text: This protected checkout retries document must never appear for the demo tenant.
